# Company of Craft

> Well-made software. Company of Craft builds stateofpixel. Founded by Vaibhav Acharya.

Every page below is also on the site as HTML, at the same address without `.md`.

## Products

- [stateofpixel](https://stateofpixel.com/index.md): Catch UI regressions before they merge.

## Small free tools

- [Open Graph preview](https://companyofcraft.com/og-preview.md): See how a link looks when you share it on X, LinkedIn, Slack and Discord, and check its Open Graph and Twitter tags.
- [Security headers checker](https://companyofcraft.com/security-headers.md): Check the Content-Security-Policy, Strict-Transport-Security and other security headers of a page.
- [Agent readability checker](https://companyofcraft.com/agent-readability.md): Check if AI agents and crawlers can read a page: robots.txt rules per crawler, llms.txt, Markdown versions, sitemap and text without JavaScript.
- [Favicon checker](https://companyofcraft.com/favicon-checker.md): Check the favicon, apple-touch-icon and web manifest of a page, with a preview of the browser tab and home screen.
